items.title: Mike De Lay Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: So one guy gave me a, I don't know, made me feel changed sort of. I took to this guy, his name was Gene Porter, a saxophone player.

ctx.x: So one guy gave me a, I don't know, made me feel changed sort of. I took to this guy, his name was Gene Porter, a saxophone player. Oh, yeah. He had just got out of Des Dune's band. Des Dune had died and he came from, I think he died in Mexico and they came over there and there was a guy by the name of Greg, played trumpet, and this little guy, Henry Halloway, his name is Kildee we call him, I think he's around New Orleans yet. Well they all came over there, oh a lot of musicians, they came over there just to get…
Yeah knowing what chord you were playing.
